originalTitle: ‘Let’s try this again’: rescheduled White House Correspondents’ Association dinner is under way – US politics live
summary: Trump on stage in Washington DC, three months after original event was interrupted by gunfire
content: Across town, the American Civil Liberties Union is holding its own awards ceremony on Friday night at another Washington DC venue. In what sounds like a dispatch from a parallel universe, while Donald Trump attends a ceremony in support of the press corps he routinely derides, the ACLU ceremony is honoring Bruce Springsteen and Colin Kaepernick, for their “profound contributions to American thought and culture”, and the civil rights lawyers Vanita Gupta, Erwin Chemerinsky and Elizabeth Foster. Earlier this year, Springsteen allowed the ACLU to use his song Born in the USA for an ad explaining what was at stake in Trump v Barbara, the US supreme court case that later overturned Trump’s attempt to deny birthright citizenship to the children of noncitizens. The awards ceremony is hosted by Laverne Cox, the actor and advocate for transgender rights. The White House Correspondents’ Association just treated the country to a cringeworthy AI video in which the founders of the American republic toasted the assembled press corps. “By the way, that was AI, in case you missed it,” the outgoing White House correspondents’ president, Weija Jiang of CBS News, pointed out, before handing over to her successor, Jacqui Heinrich, a Fox News correspondent who married a Republican congressman, Brian Fitzpatrick, last month. In May, Donald Trump dodged a question from Heinrich by instead mocking her then fiance and threatening to have him ousted from his seat for supposed disloyalty. “Her husband votes against me all the time. Can you imagine? I don’t know what’s with him. You better ask him what’s with him,” Trump said. “He likes voting against Trump. You know what happens with that? It doesn’t work out well. I don’t know why he does.” Before Donald Trump speaks to the White House Correspondents’ Association, a post-dinner ceremony celebrating journalism and the first amendment began with praise for journalists in the room who covered the attack on the prior dinner in April from Weija Jiang, the WHCA president. After Jiang said “no matter how complicated or tense the relationship is between the press and the presidency, what we share is far more important than anything else and that is our duty: to serve the American people”, her remarks were met with polite applause from most of the people room, but when the camera cut to Trump, he was not clapping. California’s attorney general, Rob Bonta, has praised an agreement reached on Friday with Warner Bros and Paramount that halts their proposed merging until 1 June 2027, or until a court rules on a challenge to the merger filed by a coalition of 12 attorneys general, whichever comes first “The Warner Bros./ Paramount merger is expected to result in higher prices, lower content quality, and fewer movies and TV shows. The proposed $110 billion merger — the largest in Hollywood history — would combine two of Hollywood’s five major film distributors and two of the five major owners of basic cable channels, extinguishing competition between Paramount and Warner Bros., and inflicting substantial harm on movie theaters, basic cable distributors, and ultimately, audiences nationwide,” Bonta’s office said in a statement. “Our argument against this illegal merger is straightforward: When too few corporations have too much power in markets central to American life, it makes things more expensive, and it makes things worse,” Bonta said. “Today’s agreement is great news for audiences, movie theaters, and the many people who write, build, and create the art, news, and entertainment so many of us enjoy. We are eager to continue to make our case in court and celebrate another tremendous win in our effort to ensure this unlawful merger never sees the light of day.” The rescheduled White House correspondents’ dinner is under way at the Waldorf Astoria in Washington DC, three months after the original event in April was interrupted by gunfire, after a man rushed through a security checkpoint outside the ballroom. Donald Trump was on stage for the opening remarks by the White House Correspondents’ Association president, CBS News correspondent Weija Jiang. “Let’s try this again, because one thing about this press corps is, we always have a follow-up,” she began. “Many of you were also with us in April. You came as guests, but within moments, you went to work.” “An assassination attempt on our president is an attack on democracy itself,” she said. “Tonight, our message is this: we are back. We will not be intimidated. We refuse to let an act of violence have the final word.” Trump is expected to speak soon. His press secretary, Karoline Leavitt, promised that the president who attacks the non-partisan media relentlessly as “the enemy of the people” would deliver “a combination of unifying yet vicious, and serious yet hilarious” remarks. The Democratic National Committee (DNC) voted on Friday to select South Carolina to lead the party’s 2028 presidential primary calendar. While the Palmetto state will kick off the calendar, five other states will follow with nominating contests ahead of Super Tuesday – the biggest single day of voting in the presidential primary season in early March. The order is as follows: South Carolina, 22 January 2028 Nevada, 1 February 2028 New Hampshire, 8 February 2028 New Mexico, 15 February 2028 Michigan, 22 February 2028 Virginia, 29 February 2028 The vote from the Rules and Bylaws Committee, in which South Carolina beat its nearest rival, Nevada, by 26-19, has to be ratified by the full DNC next month. chineseTitle: “让我们再试一次”：重新安排的白宫记者协会晚宴正在进行中——美国政治直播
chineseSummary: 特朗普在华盛顿特区的舞台上，距离最初的活动被枪声打断三个月后
chineseContent: 在城镇另一边，美国公民自由联盟将于周五晚上在华盛顿特区的另一个场所举行自己的颁奖典礼。这听起来像是来自平行宇宙的消息，唐纳德·特朗普出席了一场支持他经常嘲笑的记者团的仪式，而美国公民自由联盟的仪式则表彰布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀和科林·卡佩尼克“对美国思想和文化的深刻贡献”，以及民权律师瓦尼塔·古普塔、欧文·切莫林斯基和伊丽莎白·福斯特。今年早些时候，斯普林斯汀允许美国公民自由联盟使用他的歌曲《出生在美国》作为一则广告，解释特朗普诉芭芭拉案的利害关系，这起美国最高法院案件后来推翻了特朗普剥夺非公民子女出生公民权的企图。颁奖典礼由演员兼变性人权利倡导者拉弗恩·考克斯 (Laverne Cox) 主持。白宫记者协会刚刚向全国展示了一段令人毛骨悚然的人工智能视频，其中美利坚共和国的创始人向聚集在一起的记者团敬酒。 “顺便说一句，那是人工智能，以防你错过了，”即将卸任的白宫记者主席、哥伦比亚广播公司新闻部的 Weija Jiang 在将其移交给她的继任者、福克斯新闻记者雅基·海因里希 (Jacqui Heinrich) 之前指出，雅基·海因里希是上个月与共和党国会议员布莱恩·菲茨帕特里克 (Brian Fitzpatrick) 结婚的福克斯新闻记者。今年五月，唐纳德·特朗普回避了海因里希的提问，而是嘲笑她当时的未婚夫，并威胁要因海因里希不忠而将他赶下台。 “她丈夫一直投票反对我。你能想象吗？我不知道他怎么了。你最好问问他怎么了，”特朗普说。 “他喜欢投票反对特朗普。你知道会发生什么吗？结果并不好。我不知道他为什么这么做。”在唐纳德·特朗普向白宫通讯员发表讲话之前
